basics.name: Rahul Sharma
basics.label: AI / ML Engineer
basics.summary: Machine Learning Engineer with a strong foundation in AI, machine learning, and software development. Experienced in developing and fine-tuning AI models for computer vision and NLP, with a proven track record across research and practical implementation. Currently an SDE-2 AI/ML Engineer at ZysecAI.

work.name: ZysecAI
work.summary: Designing OCR-enabled unstructured-data ETL pipelines (hundreds of GBs to TBs); fine-tuning vision-language models for OCR (IBM Granite, SmolVLM, Qwen-VL); building retrieval pipelines that cut hallucinations by 95%; and scalable agentic systems integrating MCP servers with dynamic workflows (incident triage, compliance review, security analysis).

work.name: ZysecAI
work.summary: Architected end-to-end AI pipelines for enterprise integration; engineered complex data-processing workflows and advanced retrieval for AI agents at scale; led fine-tuning across NER, Small Language Models, and multimodal Vision-Language Models; built robust evaluation pipelines to benchmark model and pipeline performance.

work.name: ZysecAI
work.summary: Built Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for cybersecurity; developed LangChain agentic applications for real-time decision-making; optimized LLMs for memory and scalability; integrated Neo4j for graph retrieval in multi-turn dialogue.

work.name: HacktivSpace
work.summary: RAG for context retrieval in EdTech with Milvus and Neo4j; conversational memory in LLM applications; agentic workflows with LangChain and CrewAI.

work.name: HKBK College of Engineering
work.summary: Built a biomedical image VQA model with over 70% accuracy; researched fine-tuning LLaMA for medical QA; designed an R-CNN model for document fraud analysis.

work.name: Varcons Technologies
